prerequisite: complete digest-bound five-benchmark P3 natural-suite audit
matrix_interpretation: Batch and concurrency are separate controlled sweeps. c8/c32 require overlapping request-lifecycle intervals measured by the serving scheduler; serial round-robin is invalid.
paired_policy_order: alternate resident-first and tiered-first by repetition

adapter_contract.actual_concurrency_proof: request records must independently reconstruct maximum lifecycle overlap equal to the frozen concurrency; every request-token coordinate must also have a decode execution record, and c8/c32 require either a multi-request decode batch or overlapping decode execution intervals
forbidden: overlapping request lifecycles with serial decode execution
silent retry, truncation, or dropped failure

required_measurements: request admission, first-token, and completion timestamps
per-request per-token decode dispatch/completion timestamps and execution-batch identity
TTFT, TPOT, end-to-end p50/p95/p99 and maximum
generated-token throughput and terminal request failures
allocated, reserved, peak, process-total, and device-total HBM
pinned host, logical, hot, and cold cache bytes
H2D, D2H, useful-transfer bytes and counts
misses, late misses, prefetches, and evictions
claim_boundary: Actual request-concurrency evidence for the pinned adapter backend only. It is not official DeepSeek-V4 or FlashMemory evidence unless the separately frozen compatible runtime and weights are used.
